items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: He was like this boy Benny Raphael. Wonderful trombone, young trombone player. Yes, he was. Stared down on Claiborne and Calorite. He was, I mean, he was a good trombone player. Died early.

ctx.x: Camille. So violin that Johnny has then was to be for him.

That's one of the sons. He stayed on the corner and the room. Well, Henry did. Henry did. But the father lived back in Galvin Canal. But after he got to playing violin, then he got away from home. Yeah. The old man didn't want him in no band. He didn't want him. All that bunch of old ladies and the old man up on him when he got into that imperial band. He was kind of sickly anyhow. Yeah, kind of sickly father. And they didn't want him. He was like this boy Benny Raphael. Wonderful trombone, young trombone player.…
Do you remember about what years you played with the imperial band?
